fact: The Ministry of Gender says TNM Mpamba mobile money is disbursing about K6 billion in social cash transfers to over 27,760 beneficiaries in Mangochi District.

During April 2024 to March 2025, 95,520 Social Cash Transfer Programme and 195,520 public works beneficiaries in 10 World Bank-funded districts were enrolled on e-payments and received MWK 4.57 billion and MWK 21.08 billion in e-wallets, per the World Bank aide memoire citing NLGFC.
